title: sambucus sieboldiana var. miquelii
intro: Sambucus sieboldiana var. miquelii, commonly known as Japanese elderberry, is a deciduous shrub native to East Asia, belonging to the Adoxaceae family. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, which include alleviating symptoms of colds, flu, and fever, as well as its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Japanese elderberry are primarily attributed to its ability to stimulate the immune system, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antiviral activity. The bioactive constituents of Sambucus sieboldiana var. miquelii include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and anthocyanins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
